description: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella says he's AGI-pilled, at least when it comes to how AI might make startling changes to the structure of the economy and how politics might change because of it. title: Not even Sam Altman is safe from AI deepfakes on Instagram

Google is rebranding its Spark AI agent as "Tasks" and making it free to use. The feature, which is powered by Google's new Gemini 4 Hydrogen AI model, can do things like create meal plans, manage your calendar, and dig through your emails to find recurring expenses you might not need.

title: Google’s Spark AI agent becomes ‘Tasks’ — and now it’s free

author: Stevie Bonifield
description: Meta announced Direct, a new messaging app from Instagram that it's currently testing in Turkey and Thailand on iOS and Android. Direct is essentially Instagram's direct messaging without Instagram's other features. Meta says your Instagram chats will sync across both apps if you login with the same account. You can also sign up with an email or phone number, but Meta says if you use Direct without an Instagram account, "only your contacts can start a chat with you or add you to a group."
title: Meta is testing a new standalone messaging app called Direct

title: Amflow’s new urban e-bike series is deliciously overpowered for flat city streets

title: YouTube found a new way to inflate view counts

description:

But barely an hour later, one of Microsoft's worst outages in history started to unfold, leaving employees, businesses, and many governments without access to Outlook emails for nearly 24 hours.

description: Radio and TV broadcasts will be interrupted for about one minute at 2:20PM ET on Tuesday while FEMA and the FCC test the country's Emergency Alert System. Unlike recent communications outages, this is a planned interruption that FEMA is required to run every three years. FEMA says today's test includes radio and television broadcasters, cable systems, satellite radio and television providers, and wireline video providers. This test doesn't include phones
title: Get ready for a nationwide emergency alert test at 2:20PM ET today

author: Verge Staff
description:
Hundreds of gadgets pass across our desks each year. Some leave their mark and get a full review or make it to the top of a buying guide. It's harder than it sounds to narrow down our favorites. Instead of simply picking products that scored highly, or only those that made it into our buying guides, we asked our reviews team and staff at large to nominate their products of the year. Then our editors whittled the list down to the top 25, balancing categories like smart home, phones, laptops, and just cool stuff.

The result is our Best of 2026 - a list of products our staff has purchased, reviewed, or just plain loves. It's still mid-November …
title: The Verge Best of 2026
